purpose: separate evidence-supply/evaluability conditions from scientific effect/hypothesis conditions before future confirmation contracts are frozen

historical_boundary.allowed_use_on_prior_results: descriptive decomposition only; the original frozen terminal status remains authoritative

status_axes.promotion_rule: promotion requires supply_status=sufficient AND hypothesis_status=supported under the same prospectively frozen contract

country_framed_candidate_patch_confirmat.interpretation: an effect estimate may be positive while the transport/evaluability denominator is insufficient; this distinction does not retroactively promote a run that failed its original all-gates contract

provider_eligible_observability_successo.interpretation: provider/data availability determines whether the observability hypothesis is evaluable; only the AUC gates test the frozen observability effect

terminal_reporting.if_supply_not_sufficient: hypothesis_status must be unavailable unless the prospectively frozen contract explicitly defines an estimand on the available denominator
